name_zh: 特鲁多/多元文化主义先驱：多元文化联邦制与包容性公民身份
name_en: Trudeau/Multiculturalism Pioneers: Multicultural Federation & Inclusive Citizenship
description_zh: 皮埃尔·特鲁多 (1919-2000) 1971 年正式宣布"多元文化主义政策"，世界首创；1982 《权利与自由宪章》确立平等权/多元文化条款 (s.27)；贾斯汀·特鲁多 (1971-) 推进性别平衡内阁、原住民和解 (TRC)、难民接纳 (叙利亚 4 万+)。父子跨代共同体现 M174 多元文化联邦制——以"宪章权利+多元文化政策+移民积分制+原住民国家间关系"四支柱，将差异制度化为联邦粘合剂。
description_en: Pierre Trudeau (1919-2000) declared 'Multiculturalism Policy' 1971, world first; 1982 Charter entrenched equality/multiculturalism (s.27); Justin Trudeau (1971-) advances gender-balanced cabinet, indigenous reconciliation (TRC), refugee intake (Syria 40k+). Father-son cross-generational jointly exemplify M174 Multicultural Federation—four pillars of 'Charter rights + multicultural policy + immigration points system + indigenous nation-to-nation relations' institutionalizing difference as federal glue.
reason_zh: 加拿大多元文化非自然演变，而是"宪法权利+政策宣言+积分移民+原住民和解"四位一体工程建构。皮埃尔奠定法律基础，贾斯汀将其操作化为治理常态。M174 区隔于 M146 乌班图(非洲共同体)、M162 多元文化联邦(理论)，核心在于"宪法锚定差异包容+移民筛选机制+原住民自决"的治理三角。
reason_en: Canadian multiculturalism not organic evolution but engineered trinity of 'constitutional rights + policy declaration + points immigration + indigenous reconciliation'. Pierre laid legal foundation, Justin operationalized as governance norm. M174 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (African communal) and M162 Multicultural Federation (theory), core: 'constitution-anchored difference inclusion + immigration screening + indigenous self-determination' governance triangle.
steps_zh: 1971 政策宣言：特鲁多父在下议院宣布多元文化主义为联邦政策，承认双语框架内的多元文化
1982 宪章锚定：权利与自由宪章 s.15 平等权 + s.27 多元文化解释条款，司法可强制执行
积分移民制度化：1967 积分制/2002 IRPA/2015 快速通道，技能/语言/适应性量化筛选，年均 30 万+
原住民国家间关系：1996 RCAP/2008 道歉/2015 TRC 94 项呼吁/UNDRIP 立法，自决权联邦化
性别/难民/气候延伸：性别平衡内阁/叙利亚难民 4 万+/碳税/2030 净零，包容性外溢至全球治理
steps_en: 1971 Policy declaration: Trudeau père announces multiculturalism as federal policy in Commons, recognizing pluralism within bilingual framework
1982 Charter anchoring: Charter s.15 equality + s.27 multicultural interpretive clause, judicially enforceable
Points immigration institutionalization: 1967 points/2002 IRPA/2015 Express Entry, skills/language/adaptability quantified screening, 300k+ annually
Indigenous nation-to-nation relations: 1996 RCAP/2008 apology/2015 TRC 94 Calls/UNDRIP legislation, self-determination federalized
Gender/refugee/climate extension: gender-balanced cabinet/Syrian refugees 40k+/carbon tax/2030 net-zero, inclusivity spills to global governance
expected_zh: 以"宪法权利+积分移民+原住民和解"三位一体，实现高移民率社会的高信任/高创新/低冲突，多元文化指数长期全球前列。
expected_en: Trinity of 'constitutional rights + points immigration + indigenous reconciliation' achieves high-trust/high-innovation/low-conflict in high-immigration society, multicultural index consistently global top tier.
case_zh: 外国出生人口 23%+ (G7 最高)；多元文化政策指数 MIPEX 全球前 3；2021 人口普查 450+ 族裔来源；原住民语言复振投入创历史新高。
case_en: Foreign-born 23%+ (G7 highest); MIPEX multicultural policy index global top 3; 2021 census 450+ ethnic origins; indigenous language revitalization funding historic high.
cross_cultural_impact: Multiculturalism policy model globally; Charter as constitutional export; immigration points system replication
colonial_history: British/French colonial; gradual sovereignty; residential schools legacy
resource_curse_mitigation: Equalization payments; provincial resource ownership; carbon pricing revenue recycling
climate_adaptation: Carbon pricing; Arctic sovereignty; permafrost infrastructure; wildfire management
